result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, but I could not run it. Running `java` needed approval, which I did not have, so the help output and the landscape run are unverified. The `cli` module compiles offline, and it has no tests.

What changed:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument overview next to `updateLandscape`, with the same landscape options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the existing `updateLandscape` method, so behaviour and options are identical. `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed, with the matching description. `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own description.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Command line commands" section covering both names and pointing to `-help`.

Still to check by running it: `analyzeLandscape -help`, `updateLandscape -help`, the no-argument overview, and `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` creating `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`.
